run_stats_calculator: run the stats calculator script with a CSV file and log folder to compute overall episode statistics
calculate_column_averages: calculate average values for all numeric columns in a CSV file and return a DataFrame
count_successful_actions: count successful rearrange and place actions for each agent from JSON log files in a folder
count_hallucination_errors: count hallucination errors including object name errors, action name errors, and syntax errors from agent log files
count_embodiment_errors: count embodiment, reachability, and affordance errors from agent log files and calculate error fractions per episode
